flow.name: Copy the newest export as a file, then paste

Run.command:
if ! ls "$HOME/Downloads" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "macOS blocks access to Downloads: allow CursorPie in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Files and Folders (or Full Disk Access)."
  exit 1
fi
latest="$(find "$HOME/Downloads" "$HOME/Desktop" "$HOME/Documents" -maxdepth 2 -type f -mmin -120 \( -iname '*.png' -o -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' -o -iname '*.pdf' -o -iname '*.svg' -o -iname '*.webp' -o -iname '*.tif' -o -iname '*.tiff' -o -iname '*.gif' -o -iname '*.psd' -o -iname '*.eps' -o -iname '*.heic' -o -iname '*.avif' \) -exec stat -f '%m %N' {} + 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n 1 | cut -d ' ' -f 2-)"
if [ -z "$latest" ] || [ ! -f "$latest" ]; then
  echo "No exported file (last 2 hours) in Downloads, Desktop or Documents."
  exit 1
fi
if ! { osascript -l JavaScript -e 'ObjC.import("AppKit");function run(argv){var pb=$.NSPasteboard.generalPasteboard;pb.clearContents;var ok=pb.writeObjects($([$.NSURL.fileURLWithPath(argv[0])]));if(!ok){throw new Error("write failed");}return "ok";}' "$latest" >/dev/null 2>&1 || osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'set the clipboard to ((POSIX file (item 1 of argv)) as alias)' -e 'end run' "$latest" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; then
  echo "Could not put the file on the clipboard: $latest"
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s' "$latest"

Native.b: The file is still on the clipboard.
